intent_en: To inform viewers about the recommended timing for receiving COVID-19 booster shots based on the specific vaccine type and the time required for full effectiveness.
previous_intent: To explain the recommended waiting periods for COVID-19 booster shots based on the initial vaccine type and the time required to reach full effectiveness.
narration_support: you should wait six months after your second dose of COVID vaccine if you got the Pfizer or Moderna vaccine before getting a boost. And you should wait two months after getting the Johnson and Johnson vaccine before getting a boost.
chart_support: Horizontal bar chart displaying 'Months since last shot' for Pfizer/BioNTech, Moderna, Johnson & Johnson, and AstraZeneca, illustrating waiting intervals and a 'two weeks until fully effective' period.
evidence_note: Narration provides specific waiting recommendations for boosters (6 months for Pfizer/Moderna, 2 months for J&J) and effectiveness time (2 weeks), which aligns with the timeline and annotations in the chart.
